name: line-chart
accessibility_note: Provide a data-table toggle; avoid relying on color alone for series

name: area-chart
accessibility_note: Use pattern fills or labels in addition to color for stacked areas

name: bar-chart
accessibility_note: Sort bars meaningfully; label values directly for screen readers

name: horizontal-bar-chart
accessibility_note: Preferred over vertical bars when category names are long

name: grouped-bar-chart
accessibility_note: Limit to 3-4 series max; add legend with sufficient contrast

name: stacked-bar-chart
accessibility_note: Order segments consistently; provide totals as text alternative

name: pie-chart
accessibility_note: Limit to 5-6 slices max; always label percentages directly

name: donut-chart
data_type: Part-to-whole with a central KPI label
accessibility_note: Use center label for the key metric; avoid for >6 categories

name: scatter-plot
accessibility_note: Use shape + color redundantly to distinguish groups

name: bubble-chart
accessibility_note: Cap bubble count; provide a legend for size scale

name: heatmap
accessibility_note: Use a colorblind-safe sequential palette, not red-green

name: funnel-chart
accessibility_note: Always show absolute numbers alongside percentages

name: gauge-chart
data_type: Single metric progress toward a target
accessibility_note: Pair with a numeric label; don't rely on needle position alone

name: radar-chart
data_type: Comparing multiple dimensions for one/few entities
accessibility_note: Limit to 2-3 overlapping entities to stay legible

name: treemap
accessibility_note: Provide a table alternative; nested labels can be inaccessible

name: sankey-diagram
accessibility_note: Complex for screen readers; always ship a data table fallback

name: candlestick-chart
data_type: OHLC financial price movement over time
accessibility_note: Pair up/down colors with shape (filled/hollow) for colorblind users

name: sparkline
data_type: Compact inline trend next to a KPI
accessibility_note: Provide the numeric trend value in adjacent text, not chart-only

name: calendar-heatmap
data_type: Daily activity/streak intensity over a year
accessibility_note: Include a text summary of streaks for screen-reader users

name: waterfall-chart
data_type: Sequential positive/negative contributions to a total
accessibility_note: Use consistent color coding for increase vs decrease with icons
